verdict.rationale: Ardent has no documented bulk command for acting on many branches or connectors at once. The closest support is a per-connector post-create SQL hook that runs on every new branch, plus scriptable CLI/API building blocks (JSON output, token auth, idempotent re-runs) that let users loop over items themselves. The marketing line about agents cleaning and deduplicating data refers to SQL the agent runs on a branch, not a product bulk feature. Missing for 10: native bulk or batch operations across branches or connectors (e.g., multi-select delete or apply), documented batch API endpoints, and hands-on evidence of bulk workflows.
